headline: Record profit at Microsoft, as data-center spending cuts free cash flow
seo_title: Microsoft FY2026 results: record profit, lower free cash flow
description: Microsoft's fiscal 2026 annual results from its 10-K: revenue up 17.8% to $331.8 billion, a 46.8% operating margin, and capital spending of $115.9 billion that cut free cash flow to $67.0 billion.
summary: Revenue grew 17.8% to $331.8 billion and operating margin hit 46.8%. Capital spending rose 80% to $115.9 billion, so free cash flow fell for a second year.
